title: Adjuster Bulletin — Depreciation Recognized on HomeGuard Dwelling Water Damage by Coverage Form
content:
This bulletin sets how much depreciation is recognized on dwelling water damage under the HomeGuard Homeowners Policy when that damage is settled in place of a repeated-seepage denial, and it turns on the coverage form of the package and on the tier's no-holdback threshold. The depreciation recognized is the amount by which the replacement-cost value of the dwelling water damage is reduced in settling it.

## The rule

- **HO-5 form, replacement-cost value above the no-holdback threshold.** Depreciation is recognized on materials only, at 45 percent of the recorded depreciation; the labor share of 55 percent is not depreciated.
- **HO-3 form, replacement-cost value above the no-holdback threshold.** The depreciation recognized is the recorded depreciation, but never more than 40 percent of the replacement-cost value.
- **Replacement-cost value at or below the no-holdback threshold.** No such recognition rule applies.

The replacement-cost value and the recorded depreciation are those on the dwelling damage's repeated-seepage denial entry of the claim.

## Coverage form and no-holdback threshold by package

| Package | Coverage form | No-holdback threshold (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| HomeGuard HO-3 Essential | HO-3 | 0 |
| HomeGuard HO-3 Enhanced | HO-3 | 1000 |
| HomeGuard HO-3 Premier | HO-3 | 2500 |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Enhanced | HO-5 | 1000 |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Premier | HO-5 | 2500 |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Signature | HO-5 | 10000 |

"Above the threshold" means strictly greater than the figure in the table; a replacement-cost value equal to it is at the threshold.

## Worked cases (hypothetical figures)

| Case | Package | Replacement-cost value | Recorded depreciation | Depreciation recognized |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | HO-5 Premier | 20000.00 | 6000.00 | 45 percent of 6000.00, that is 2700.00 |
| 2 | HO-3 Enhanced | 20000.00 | 9000.00 | capped at 40 percent of 20000.00, that is 8000.00 |
| 3 | HO-3 Enhanced | 20000.00 | 6000.00 | 6000.00 (below the 8000.00 cap) |
| 4 | HO-3 Enhanced | 20000.00 | 8000.00 | 8000.00 (exactly at the cap) |
| 5 | HO-3 Premier | 2500.00 | 700.00 | at the threshold: no such recognition rule applies |
| 6 | HO-3 Premier | 2500.01 | 700.00 | above the threshold: 700.00, below the 40 percent cap of 1000.00 |
| 7 | HO-5 Signature | 10000.00 | 3000.00 | at the threshold: no such recognition rule applies |
| 8 | HO-5 Signature | 10000.01 | 3000.00 | above the threshold: 45 percent of 3000.00, that is 1350.00 |
| 9 | HO-3 Essential | 500.00 | 150.00 | above the threshold of 0: 150.00, below the cap of 200.00 |

The amounts in the cases are hypothetical inputs chosen for illustration only.

## Notes for adjusters

- The HO-5 recognition is a share of the recorded depreciation (45 percent); it is not compared with the replacement-cost value.
- The HO-3 recognition is the recorded depreciation itself, limited by a cap of 40 percent of the replacement-cost value; where the recorded depreciation is at or below that cap, it is recognized in full.
